candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory failing with timeout/DependencyUnavailable (~2s), causing inventory 503 and order ReadTimeout, propagating 502 to /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs excluded; root cause of the redis timeout (load, saturation, network) not established.

report.explanation: Traces show repeated redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory, cascading to order ReadTimeout and gateway 502s on /v1/checkout; metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2.4s) and 502s. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout. Redis-side telemetry is excluded, so the underlying cause of the timeout remains unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Redis dependency metrics (latency, errors, saturation) for inventory's redis to confirm the timeout origin
Inventory service logs around the failing reserve_inventory calls
